expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds image output (PPM) or the first milestone with TODOs; no full ray tracer
expectations.evidence: Wrote only a 1213-char skeleton raytracer/main.cpp for milestone 1 (image output) with TODOs: "TODO 1: write the three header lines", "TODO 2: nested loop over all pixels", "TODO 3: ... done message", and told the learner "Your job is the core: the pixel loop." No vec3, camera, spheres, or shading — no full ray tracer.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Final answer ends with a checkpoint section: "How to check it:" giving concrete commands "g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -o raytracer main.cpp && ./raytracer" then "open out.ppm", and expected behaviour: "Pass = a smooth gradient, green in the top-left corner fading toward red at bottom-right, with a bluish tint."

expectations.text: B3: Uses a simple image format such as PPM so no graphics library is needed, or justifies another choice
expectations.evidence: Uses PPM P3 and justifies it: "PPM P3 is the simplest one in existence — a text header, then `r g b` numbers for every pixel... No library, no compression, every image viewer reads it." Skeleton targets out.ppm in P3 format.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: "SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0)"; only tool calls were read AGENTS.md, todo_write, and write raytracer/main.cpp (inside the project dir). No install commands run or written; the g++ build command is left for the learner to run themselves.
